cases.input: Prepare an upcoming decision meeting from confirmed calendar facts, confirmed participant roles, and two current evidence notes. Preserve claim provenance and confidence while focusing only on decisions, risks, open questions, and concrete preparation.
requiredBehaviors: separate confirmed meeting facts from objectives, decisions, open questions, risks, and preparation actions
preserve evidence-note claim provenance, confidence, and contradictions
produce a concise immediately usable meeting brief without duplicating retrieval logic
forbiddenBehaviors: invent participant motives or unverified authority
claim calendar, contact, or document actions were executed

cases.input: A participant is confirmed but their decision authority is unclear, and two high-quality evidence claims conflict. Prepare the meeting without resolving either uncertainty by assumption.
requiredBehaviors: keep the participant decision role explicitly unknown
preserve the evidence conflict and carry it into meeting risks
turn unresolved high-impact uncertainty into a concrete clarification question
forbiddenBehaviors: assign decision authority from job title or context alone
average or silently choose between contradictory evidence claims

cases.input: A draft meeting prep infers that one attendee is resistant, upgrades a low-confidence claim to certain, and says missing documents have already been requested although no connector action occurred.
requiredBehaviors: restore the original evidence confidence and provenance
represent unexecuted preparation work as a pending action rather than a completed fact
forbiddenBehaviors: present unexecuted connector actions as completed
skillAnchors: Confidence und Konflikte wurden nicht „hochgestuft“ oder entfernt
